read_gap.handling: Archive No-Read Fence preserved; no broad archive read or stale-derived inference. Fresh MISSION_STATE and exact-current executable/contract files control this review.

agreements: v2.1 separates verified_experience_delta from operational_progress_delta at the output boundary.
Anti-thrash does not block inherited safety/recovery downshift because it applies only to selected_n > current_n.
Speedup remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and must use operational metrics rather than commit count or awake time.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied, not derived from trusted timestamp/TTL/source/authority/replay evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive them from a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope bound to exact signal and fresh authority snapshot; caller booleans are diagnostic-only or rejected.

disagreements.finding: non-bool freshness/conflict values such as 'false' are truthy and can alter routing.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool values fail-closed before routing; strict typing does not replace freshness/authority binding.

disagreements.finding: verified Experience is controlled by event_kind plus a free verification flag without exact evidence hash, independent verifier/C receipt, mission/step, installation/workspace, freshness or revocation binding.
disagreements.required_change: Require exact canonical evidence/event fingerprint plus trusted independent-verifier/C receipt and acceptance binding.

disagreements.finding: bool(...) converts 'false','0', nonempty lists/mappings into True in verification paths.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool verification values fail-closed, then require evidence-bound verifier receipt.

disagreements.finding: dedupe trusts caller event_id; identical evidence can be replayed under arbitrarily many IDs.
disagreements.required_change: Uniqueness authority must be canonical evidence lineage plus verifier receipt identity.

disagreements.finding: seen=set() is recreated on every aggregate call, so identical event_id/evidence can be re-credited after another call, poll, process/window restart or rollback.
disagreements.required_change: Use durable replay-resistant accepted-event/evidence registry with installation/workspace binding and monotonic rollback protection.

disagreements.finding: event_id has no immutable binding to event_kind, canonical event/evidence hash or verifier receipt. Across runs the same ID can be rebound from operational/unverified semantics to a verified kind, and transient per-call dedupe cannot detect the mutation.
disagreements.required_change: Seal EventIdentity on first acceptance: event_id + canonical_event_hash + event_kind + evidence_hash + verifier_receipt_hash + source/install/workspace identity. Same-ID/different-binding => IDENTITY_CONFLICT with zero credit; exact same binding replay => exactly-once no-op.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied; forged low bypasses anti-thrash and forged high suppresses safe nonessential upshift.
disagreements.required_change: Derive it from canonical append-only shift ledger and versioned observation window, binding numerator/denominator/window/sample count/runtime identity/policy hash.

disagreements.finding: ratio>=0.50 has no sample size, denominator, window or confidence semantics; 1/1 can look stable.
disagreements.required_change: Require precommitted minimum support/window/release semantics; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: hold can suppress necessary safe upshift indefinitely while high rate persists, hiding cycle/closure/recovery latency regression.
disagreements.required_change: Add bounded hold/release/cooldown and paired non-regression tests.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is caller-supplied and currently reason-only; behavioral use could become self-reinforcing.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived over a precommitted denominator/window and proven non-self-reinforcing.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics; equal sums are not calibrated capability/truth/trust/personality equivalence.
disagreements.required_change: Forbid aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold; weights remain TEST_REQUIRED.

Compare matched workloads on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk; commit/wake/awake time excluded.

statistical_risks: Caller-controlled shift-rate provenance permits anti-thrash activation or bypass bias.
Small-n shift ratios can create false-positive anti-thrash.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle/recovery latency or verified closure throughput.
verified_progress_density lacks denominator/window/independence and can become self-reinforcing.
Transient dedupe creates longitudinal inflation across polling/restarts.
Unsealed event identity permits cross-run semantic/evidence rebinding without new canonical evidence.
5/4/3 credits are ordinal heuristics, not interval-scale capability measurements.
Unmatched speed comparisons are confounded by task mix, incidents, verifier availability, route complexity and runtime conditions.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001 stale RED/ORANGE with forged freshness must fail closed.
GB21-AUTHORITY-CONFLICT-002 newer authority wins despite caller authority_conflict=false.
GB21-FRESHNESS-CLOCK-003 rollback/forward clock jump, expired TTL and replay cannot regain freshness.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 1/1 and 2/3 cannot activate production anti-thrash without support semantics.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005 stable demand after burst regains safe upshift within bounded policy with non-regressed cycle/closure/recovery metrics.
GB21-SAFETY-UPSHIFT-006 safe-service upshift cannot be indefinitely suppressed.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007 caller density=1.0 confers no routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008 same canonical evidence under 10,000 distinct IDs credits once.
GB21-VERIFIER-BOOL-COERCION-009 non-bool verification inputs reject fail-closed.
GB21-SECRETARY-BOOL-COERCION-010 non-bool secretary freshness/conflict inputs reject.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011 verified kind without exact evidence hash+trusted verifier receipt gets zero verified credit.
GB21-CROSS-EVENT-EVIDENCE-012 multiple IDs bound to same evidence/receipt count once; one ID rebound to different evidence conflicts.

GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013 DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND affect operational progress only; verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance and formal authority byte-identical.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014 equal aggregate score from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 matched baseline/candidate reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency and verification/risk non-regression; commit/wake/awake time excluded.
GB21-V1-V2-NONREGRESSION-016 verified v1 and current v2 suites remain preserved.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 caller ratio contradicting trusted shift ledger is ignored/rejected; canonical derivation wins.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 same accepted verified event across 1,000 fresh invocations/restarts receives one canonical credit total.
GB21-ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 rollback/replay cannot re-credit accepted evidence; trusted monotonic anchor detects registry rollback.
GB21-POLL-REPLAY-020 repeated polling of same durable event leaves counters invariant after first acceptance; poll remains zero Experience.

GB21-EVENT-REBIND-021 accept e1 as DURABLE_PROGRESS/evidence=A, then in fresh run present e1 as VERIFIED_CAPABILITY/evidence=B or changed verifier receipt; must return IDENTITY_CONFLICT and zero additional credit; exact original binding replay is no-op.
release_condition: No C PASS claim and no formal/code mutation.
Fresh secretary influence derives from trusted replay-resistant freshness evidence and exact authority comparison; non-bool freshness/conflict fails closed.
Verified Experience requires strict verification typing plus exact evidence/event fingerprint and trusted independent-verifier/C receipt.
Experience uniqueness resists same-evidence/new-ID laundering and same-ID/different-binding rebinding.
Exactly-once accepted-event/evidence semantics persist across repeated calls, polling, process/window restart and rollback using durable monotonic state.
recent_shift_rate is internally derived from canonical shift ledger with precommitted window/sample semantics; anti-thrash cannot hide material cycle/closure/recovery regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and causal/non-self-reinforcing tests pass.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; runtime maintenance remains zero Experience; P_base stays read-only.
Credit weights remain heuristic TEST_REQUIRED and cannot become promotion/capability/Trust/Identity/Personality truth.

Any speedup claim requires paired matched baseline on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with verification/risk non-regression.
Verified Gearbox v1 and Step009 Heartbeat foundations remain preserved; v2.1 affected scope remains candidate until normal A->B->C adoption.
